name: Napaisaurus
sum: A basal iguanodontian from the Early Cretaceous Xinlong Formation of Guangxi, China, known from a right ilium and ischium.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: FS-20-007-008, a right ilium and ischium found in 2020.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Ji and Zhang 2022
